outcome: perceived areas for improvement in care
cohort: 373 postpartum women with a mean age of 26 years, predominantly of mixed race, with low levels of education and income
finding: Significant associations were found between the presence of a companion during labor and delivery and freedom to ask questions, lower levels of education and less information received, vaginal birth and disrespect from healthcare professionals, and being of white race and having a companion present with higher satisfaction with care.
mod_finding: Vaginal birth was associated with disrespect from healthcare professionals.
